claire.design: UX quickie — Trace header CTAs. Current: Export primary, copy icon tiny. Thoughts on flipping? raj.product: Flip. Copy corr-id is the most common action for support and linking. morgan.pm: metrics confirm it (copy ~4x export last 30d). sam.eng: Export can be expensive for big traces; if we demote it we should show queued/asynchronous states. claire.design: Proposal: Primary = Copy chip (text button), Secondary = Export dropdown (JSON/CSV with small descriptors). Mobile: collapse export into kebab. aria.a11y: A11y checklist: chip must be keyboard-focusable, aria-label includes full id and action, aria-live region announces copy success, expose full id to screen readers (no ellipsis). sam.eng: Implementation notes: add hidden
, return job-id for exports, and poll job-status. For big jobs show "Export queued — we'll email you". morgan.pm: Emit events: trace.copy_corr_id, trace.export_requested, trace.export_ready (include file_size/format). claire.design: I'll update mock with states: idle, copying (transient check + SR announcement), export queued, export ready (download link + SR). Pushing spec shortly. :sparkles:
